fixes.explanation: Ooh, the Levites are a good guess, friend, but they didn't make the guest list on this one. The verse names one person to receive the payment. He gives the value plus a fifth "…to the priest…" (Leviticus 5:16). That same priest is the one who makes atonement with the ram as a guilt offering, so the verse keeps its eyes on him.

problems.problem: The passage names the priest as the recipient; it does not say Levites are excluded. Also, saying the priest handles the whole thing from start to finish goes beyond the text: the person makes restitution and brings the offering.
